correction_reason.description: Optional bounded reason category when is_correction=true (see docs/234).

correction_reason_detail.description: Optional short human explanation when is_correction=true; keep concise (digest-first, screenshot-last).

cro_hash.description: Optional CRO link: cro_hash of the CRO this update corresponds to.

is_correction.description: If true, this update represents a correction/amendment rather than a purely additive update. Verifiers may allow decreases only when is_correction=true and linkage/reasoning is present.

prev_cro_hash.description: Optional CRO link: cro_hash of the CRO this update supersedes (for link-forward correction chains).

prev_hash.description: Hash of previous ENRUpdate canonical bytes
